title: antrophyum lineatum
intro: Antrophyum lineatum, commonly known as the Lineated Leptosporangiate Fern, is a species of fern native to tropical regions of Asia and Australia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Antrophyum lineatum include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of this plant may also contribute to its antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
